policy: The copied app starts from the captured stock entitlement plist. Only these Apple-bound keys may be removed. Exactly one added entitlement, com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation=true, is required to load Apple-signed nested frameworks after local top-level signing; no entitlement values may be changed. Sandbox remains required; task-port/get-task-allow, debugger, and DYLD-environment entitlements remain forbidden.
